findings.summary: Intel cycle-5 Unbrowse route-ladder reproduction (repair round 0 of the rejected cycle-2 attempt): preregistered A/B/C ladder executed on 4 sandbox sites (restful-booker UI+REST, httpbin replay control, books+quotes.toscrape). Frozen decision rule evaluated exactly once -> VERDICT REPRODUCED_USEFUL: cached-route replay beat full browser traversal 5/5 paired wins on BOTH panels with median speedups 37.05x and 8.66x; zero unhealthy rows, warmups excluded, 0 exclusions. CRITICAL BOUNDARY NUANCE: C/B median ratios 0.92 and 0.73 - bare HTTP fetch of the known endpoint nearly MATCHES cached-route replay latency on these sandbox sites, i.e. the big win is vs browser traversal, and the route abstraction added little beyond plain curl-level HTTP here.

Independent audit: measurement STANDS (every headline recomputed from passes_raw.json with zero mismatches; selftest rerun 25/25 PASS; prereg frozen-implementation hashes match committed code 11/11) but gate = REVISE / VALIDATED_USEFUL / safe_to_integrate=false on documentary-only RF-1..RF-4: missing cycle5_report.md although decision_rule.json cites 'report section 5'; state/intel_reproduction.json still carries cycle-1 SGDR content; stale intel_candidate.json; hardcoded checker-taxonomy counts. Predeclared flip condition: exact delivery => next audit PASSes on spot-check alone. Wording ceiling PROOF OF CONCEPT.
